# PhotonicIonicCrosstalk

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Unintended interference between adjacent photo-iontronic devices due to light scattering or ion diffusion, affecting synaptic precision. Understanding and mitigating this crosstalk is critical for scaling dense neuromorphic vision arrays without degrading computational accuracy.
